podcast.body: U2's "The Joshua Tree" was characterized as a "mainstream pop rock breakthrough" album, signifying its significant impact and success when it won Album of the Year in 1988. "You two's mainstream pop rock breakthrough, The Joshua Tree, which took the prize in 1988."

podcast.title: Advertising and Hit Parade
podcast.body: The intricate "dance" between the advertising industry and the pop charts has yielded numerous peculiar stories. These include pop hits that gained traction before their advertising connections were known, and advertisements that transformed previously obscure artists into widely beloved pop figures. "The dance between the advertising industry and the hit parade has produced so many strange stories."

podcast.body: The late 90s saw a generation of bands that existed at the crossroads between mainstream pop rock and alternative music, contributing to a diverse musical landscape. "estaba medio camino entre el pop rock de gran consumo y la música alternativa."
